component.name: TabExtend
component.summary: Use an Android tablet as a second screen

description.p: TabExtend turns an Android tablet into a wireless extended monitor for your Linux desktop. Drag windows onto the tablet and use it with touch, a pen, a mouse or a keyboard. The computer's sound can play on the tablet too.

ul.li: Wireless over your local network, no cable needed
Pair by scanning a QR code or comparing a six-digit code
Encrypted with TLS 1.3; only paired tablets can connect
Hardware video encoding on Intel, AMD and NVIDIA, chosen automatically
Works on GNOME and KDE Plasma

description.p: Install the TabExtend app on the tablet from the project's releases.
Touch and keyboard input, smooth 60 fps, sound on the tablet, a desktop app and a new tablet app.
